description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) SUPPRESSION VOLLEYS (Gravis Siege Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privilege: the Flash Gitz are moved 16" forward.
